Treatise 19

災異五
Portents and Anomalies 5
3
洪範曰：「土爰稼穡。 」不成則為咎徵。 凡恒風霾、晦冥、花妖、蟲孽、牛禍、地震、山頹、雨毛、地生毛、年饑、黃眚、黃祥皆屬之於土。
The Great Plan states, "Earth is defined as bringing forth the harvest." When earth fails in this office, the result is a sign of cosmic blame." Persistent unseasonable wind and haze, unnatural darkness, floral prodigies, insect plagues, bovine calamities, earthquakes, mountain collapses, fiber-like rain, hair sprouting from the soil, famine years, and yellow portents of every kind all belong to the element of earth.
4
順治二年七月，湖州大風拔木。 三年二月，孝感大風拔木。 五年六月，無為州大風，壞屋拔木。 八月，海豐颶風，毀廬舍無算。 六年正月，潞安飆風大作。 五月，五河狂風晝夜不息，大木盡拔。 八月，惠來颶風大作，四晝夜不息，毀官署民舍。 七年二月，阜陽、襄陽、漳南大風，拔木覆屋。 九年五月，東陽大風拔木。 十年八月，澄海颶風大作，舟吹陸地，屋飛空中，官署民房盡毀，壓斃男婦不計其數，從來颶風未有如此甚者。 十一年二月，太湖大風，毀城內牌坊。 六月，全椒颶風大作，屋瓦皆飛。 十二年六月，石門大風拔木。 十三年五月，章丘大風拔木。 十四年三月，平樂颶風大作，飛石拔木，民房多傾頹。 六月，石門大風毀民居。 十六年正月二十八日，嘉應州大風拔木。 十七年五月，慶元颶風拔木。
In the seventh month of the second year of Shunzhi, a violent wind at Huzhou uprooted trees. In the second month of the third year, a violent wind at Xiaogan uprooted trees. In the sixth month of the fifth year, a violent wind at Wuwei Prefecture destroyed houses and uprooted trees. In the eighth month, a typhoon at Haifeng destroyed countless dwellings. In the first month of the sixth year, a raging squall swept Lu'an. In the fifth month, a violent wind at Wuhe raged day and night without cease, uprooting every large tree. In the eighth month, a fierce typhoon at Huilai raged for four days and nights without abating, destroying government offices and private homes. In the second month of the seventh year, violent winds at Fuyang, Xiangyang, and Zhangnan uprooted trees and collapsed houses. In the fifth month of the ninth year, a violent wind at Dongyang uprooted trees. In the eighth month of the tenth year, a typhoon of unprecedented violence struck Chenghai, blowing boats onto dry land and houses through the air, leveling every government office and private dwelling, and crushing countless men and women to death—no typhoon within living memory had ever been so devastating. In the second month of the eleventh year, a violent wind at Taihu destroyed the memorial arches within the city walls. In the sixth month, a fierce typhoon at Quanjiao tore every roof tile from its moorings. In the sixth month of the twelfth year, a violent wind at Shimen uprooted trees. In the fifth month of the thirteenth year, a violent wind at Zhangqiu uprooted trees. In the third month of the fourteenth year, a fierce typhoon at Pingle sent stones flying and uprooted trees, and many private homes were toppled. In the sixth month, a violent wind at Shimen destroyed private homes. On the twenty-eighth day of the first month of the sixteenth year, a violent wind at Jiaying Prefecture uprooted trees. In the fifth month of the seventeenth year, a typhoon at Qingyuan uprooted trees.
5
康熙元年八月初三日，寧海颶風三晝夜，宜興大風雨拔木。 二年，遂溪颶風拔木。 三年四月，臨城大風傷人。 七月，清河颶風壞廬舍無算； 慈谿大風雨，大木盡拔。 八月，嘉興颶風大作，拔木飛瓦。 四年二月，江陰大風拔木。 五月，東陽大風雷雨並至，拔木壞屋。 七月，嘉應州大風拔木。 八月，長樂大風拔木。 五年五月，海陽颶風拔木。 八月，澄海颶風傷稼。 六年四月，信宜大風，牆垣皆頹。 七年四月，東陽大風雨，壓倒民居七所，拔木無算。 六月，太平大風拔木。 七月，瑞安大風，毀城垣廬舍。 八年四月，大冶大風拔木。 六月，海寧大風拔木。 九年春，崇陽大風拔木。 五月，全椒大風拔木。 六月，安縣大風拔木，三晝夜乃息。 七月，武定大風拔木。
On the third day of the eighth month of the first year of Kangxi, a typhoon at Ninghai raged for three days and nights, while at Yixing violent wind and rain uprooted trees. In the second year, a typhoon at Suixi uprooted trees. In the fourth month of the third year, a violent wind at Lincheng injured people. In the seventh month, a typhoon at Qinghe destroyed countless dwellings; at Cixi, violent wind and rain uprooted every large tree. In the eighth month, a fierce typhoon at Jiaxing uprooted trees and tore roof tiles from their places. In the second month of the fourth year, a violent wind at Jiangyin uprooted trees. In the fifth month, Dongyang was struck simultaneously by violent wind and thunderstorm, which uprooted trees and destroyed houses. In the seventh month, a violent wind at Jiaying Prefecture uprooted trees. In the eighth month, a violent wind at Changle uprooted trees. In the fifth month of the fifth year, a typhoon at Haiyang uprooted trees. In the eighth month, a typhoon at Chenghai damaged the standing grain. In the fourth month of the sixth year, a violent wind at Xinyi collapsed every wall. In the fourth month of the seventh year, violent wind and rain at Dongyang crushed seven private homes and uprooted trees beyond number. In the sixth month, a violent wind at Taiping uprooted trees. In the seventh month, a violent wind at Ruian destroyed the city walls and private homes. In the fourth month of the eighth year, a violent wind at Daye uprooted trees. In the sixth month, a violent wind at Haining uprooted trees. In the spring of the ninth year, a violent wind at Chongyang uprooted trees. In the fifth month, a violent wind at Quanjiao uprooted trees. In the sixth month, a violent wind at An County uprooted trees and raged for three days and nights before subsiding. In the seventh month, a violent wind at Wuding uprooted trees.
6
十年正月，平遠大風拔木。 十一年七月，榆社大風殺稼； 瓊州颶風大作，官署民房悉圮無存，毀城垣十五丈。 九月，吳川颶風，壞城垣廬舍。 十二年正月，海陽颶風，拔木壞屋。 八月十六日，澄海颶風大作。 十三年二月，桐廬大風拔木。 十四年二月，武強大風殺稼。 三月，玉田大風，揚沙拔木。 六月，新城大風拔木。 十五年四月至六月，澄海颶風屢作，壞屋拔木。 十六年四月，宜城大風拔木。 六月，東陽大風，屋瓦皆飛。 十七年六月，武強大風拔木。 十八年六月，惠州大風，壞文星塔頂。 十九年秋，瓊州大風拔木。
In the first month of the tenth year, a violent wind at Pingyuan uprooted trees. In the seventh month of the eleventh year, a violent wind at Yushe destroyed the standing grain; at Qiongzhou a fierce typhoon leveled every government office and private dwelling without exception and destroyed fifteen zhang of city wall. In the ninth month, a typhoon at Wuchuan damaged the city walls and private homes. In the first month of the twelfth year, a typhoon at Haiyang uprooted trees and destroyed houses. On the sixteenth day of the eighth month, a fierce typhoon struck Chenghai. In the second month of the thirteenth year, a violent wind at Tonglu uprooted trees. In the second month of the fourteenth year, a violent wind at Wuqiang destroyed the standing grain. In the third month, a violent wind at Yutian whipped up sand and uprooted trees. In the sixth month, a violent wind at Xincheng uprooted trees. From the fourth through the sixth month of the fifteenth year, typhoons struck Chenghai repeatedly, destroying houses and uprooting trees. In the fourth month of the sixteenth year, a violent wind at Yicheng uprooted trees. In the sixth month, a violent wind at Dongyang tore every roof tile from its place. In the sixth month of the seventeenth year, a violent wind at Wuqiang uprooted trees. In the sixth month of the eighteenth year, a violent wind at Huizhou damaged the summit of the Wénxīng Pagoda. In the autumn of the nineteenth year, a violent wind at Qiongzhou uprooted trees.
7
二十一年三月，望江大風拔木。 七月，信宜大風拔木。 二十二年二月初五日，單縣大風，揚塵蔽天，倏忽變幻五色。 二十三年正月，清河大風拔木。 二十四年三月，文登大風拔木。 二十五年四月，漢中、定遠大風拔木。 五月，西充、南充大風拔木。 六月，嶽陽大風拔木。 二十六年三月，太湖大風拔木。 六月，平樂、蒼梧大風拔木壞屋。 七月，蘇州、昆山、武進大風傷禾。 二十七年五月，昌樂、壽光大風拔木。 六月，沁水大風拔木。 二十八年五月，恩縣異風，損壞城樓，吹倒石坊。 二十九年四月，鄖陽大風拔木。 五月二十六日夜，六安狂風暴起，屋瓦皆飛，大木盡拔。 八月，黃岩大風拔木。
In the third month of the twenty-first year, a violent wind at Wangjiang uprooted trees. In the seventh month, a violent wind at Xinyi uprooted trees. On the fifth day of the second month of the twenty-second year, a violent wind at Shan County raised dust that blotted out the sky, which in an instant shifted through five colors. In the first month of the twenty-third year, a violent wind at Qinghe uprooted trees. In the third month of the twenty-fourth year, a violent wind at Wendeng uprooted trees. In the fourth month of the twenty-fifth year, violent winds at Hanzhong and Dingyuan uprooted trees. In the fifth month, violent winds at Xichong and Nanchong uprooted trees. In the sixth month, a violent wind at Yueyang uprooted trees. In the third month of the twenty-sixth year, a violent wind at Taihu uprooted trees. In the sixth month, violent winds at Pingle and Cangwu uprooted trees and destroyed houses. In the seventh month, violent winds at Suzhou, Kunshan, and Wujin damaged the standing grain. In the fifth month of the twenty-seventh year, violent winds at Changle and Shouguang uprooted trees. In the sixth month, a violent wind at Qinshui uprooted trees. In the fifth month of the twenty-eighth year, an unnatural wind at En County damaged the city gate tower and toppled a stone memorial arch. In the fourth month of the twenty-ninth year, a violent wind at Yunyang uprooted trees. On the night of the twenty-sixth day of the fifth month, a raging gale burst upon Lu'an, tearing every roof tile from its place and uprooting every large tree. In the eighth month, a violent wind at Huangyan uprooted trees.
8
三十年三月，寧陽大風拔木。 四月，江浦大風，屋瓦皆飛。 三十一年正月，蓬萊大風，拔木毀屋。 二月，沛縣大風，拔木毀屋。 五月，東昌、丘縣大風拔木。 六月，高密大風拔木。 三十二年六月，營山大風拔木，風過，草木如焚。 三十三年十月十六日，鄒平怪風，吹倒城垛六座。 三十四年秋，長寧大風拔木。 三十五年七月二十二日，青浦、澤州大風拔木。 二十三日，桐鄉、石門、嘉興、湖州颶風大作，民居傾覆，壓傷人畜甚多。 八月十一日，海州大風雨，民舍盡傾。 三十七年四月，濟南大風拔木。 七月，蘇州大風拔木。 三十八年春，青州大風拔木。 六月，南樂大風拔木。
In the third month of the thirtieth year, a violent wind at Ningyang uprooted trees. In the fourth month, a violent wind at Jiangpu tore every roof tile from its place. In the first month of the thirty-first year, a violent wind at Penglai uprooted trees and destroyed houses. In the second month, a violent wind at Pei County uprooted trees and destroyed houses. In the fifth month, violent winds at Dongchang and Qiu County uprooted trees. In the sixth month, a violent wind at Gaomi uprooted trees. In the sixth month of the thirty-second year, a violent wind at Yingshan uprooted trees, and after it had passed the vegetation looked as though it had been scorched by fire. On the sixteenth day of the tenth month of the thirty-third year, an unnatural wind at Zouping toppled six sections of the city parapet. In the autumn of the thirty-fourth year, a violent wind at Changning uprooted trees. On the twenty-second day of the seventh month of the thirty-fifth year, violent winds at Qingpu and Zezhou uprooted trees. On the twenty-third day, fierce typhoons struck Tongxiang, Shimen, Jiaxing, and Huzhou, toppling private homes and crushing or injuring a great many people and livestock. On the eleventh day of the eighth month, violent wind and rain at Haizhou leveled every private dwelling. In the fourth month of the thirty-seventh year, a violent wind at Jinan uprooted trees. In the seventh month, a violent wind at Suzhou uprooted trees. In the spring of the thirty-eighth year, a violent wind at Qingzhou uprooted trees. In the sixth month, a violent wind at Nanle uprooted trees.
9
四十一年八月，開平颶風，拔木倒牆。 十月乙酉，東明大風拔木。 四十二年五月，枝江大風拔木。 六月，潮陽颶風傷稼。 四十四年四月，崇陽大風拔木。 五月，曆城、霑化、丘縣大風拔木。 四十五年六月二十夜，什邡大風自東北來，飛瓦拔木。 四十六年三月，鄒平、長山大風拔木。 四十七年五月，惠民颶風大作，毀民舍。 七月，台州大風拔木。 四十八年四月，太原大風毀牌坊。 八月，定海大風雨，孔子廟及御書樓皆圮。 四十九年三月，中衛大風拔木。
In the eighth month of the forty-first year, a typhoon at Kaiping uprooted trees and collapsed walls. On the yiyou day of the tenth month, a violent wind at Dongming uprooted trees. In the fifth month of the forty-second year, a violent wind at Zhijiang uprooted trees. In the sixth month, a typhoon at Chaoyang damaged the standing grain. In the fourth month of the forty-fourth year, a violent wind at Chongyang uprooted trees. In the fifth month, violent winds at Licheng, Zhanhua, and Qiu County uprooted trees. On the night of the twentieth day of the sixth month of the forty-fifth year, a violent wind from the northeast struck Shifang, sending roof tiles flying and uprooting trees. In the third month of the forty-sixth year, violent winds at Zouping and Changshan uprooted trees. In the fifth month of the forty-seventh year, a fierce typhoon at Huimin destroyed countless private homes. In the seventh month, a violent wind at Taizhou uprooted trees. In the fourth month of the forty-eighth year, a violent wind at Taiyuan destroyed memorial arches. In the eighth month, violent wind and rain at Dinghai collapsed both the Confucius Temple and the Imperial Calligraphy Pavilion. In the third month of the forty-ninth year, a violent wind at Zhongwei uprooted trees.
10
五十年三月，祁州大風毀南城樓。 五月，安丘、諸城大風拔木。 五十一年四月，香山颶風拔木。 八月，寨城、富川大風拔木。 九月，北流大風拔木。 五十二年三月，全州大風雨雹，屋瓦皆飛，大木盡拔。 六月，潮陽大風壞北橋。 五十三年五月，固安大風拔木。 六月，順義大風，樹木盡拔。 五十四年六月初一日，潮陽颶風拔木。 五十五年閏三月朔，解州大風拔木。 四月辛亥，靜寧州大風拔木。 五十六年七月十九日，掖縣暴風雨一晝夜，大木盡拔。 五十七年五月，澄海颶風拔木。 六月，湯溪大風，拔巨木，壞廬舍。 七月，日照、黃縣大風雨一晝夜，大木盡拔。 五十八年五月，乾州大風拔木。 六月，寶坻大風拔木。 八月十九日夜，揭陽颶風大作，風中如燐火，樹木皆枯； 澄海颶風大作，民房傾覆，壓倒男婦無算。 五十九年正月，陽春颶風傷稼。 六十年八月，澄海颶風大作，如燐火，毀城垣。 六十一年四月，甘泉大風拔木。 五月，慶雲大風拔木。 十二月，欽州大風雨，吹塌城垣二十餘丈。
In the third month of the fiftieth year, a violent wind at Qizhou destroyed the south gate tower. In the fifth month, violent winds at Anqiu and Zhucheng uprooted trees. In the fourth month of the fifty-first year, a typhoon at Xiangshan uprooted trees. In the eighth month, violent winds at Zaicheng and Fuchuan uprooted trees. In the ninth month, a violent wind at Beiliu uprooted trees. In the third month of the fifty-second year, violent wind, rain, and hail at Quanzhou sent every roof tile flying and uprooted every large tree. In the sixth month, a violent wind at Chaoyang destroyed the north bridge. In the fifth month of the fifty-third year, a violent wind at Gu'an uprooted trees. In the sixth month, a violent wind at Shunyi uprooted every tree. On the first day of the sixth month of the fifty-fourth year, a typhoon at Chaoyang uprooted trees. On the first day of the intercalary third month of the fifty-fifth year, a violent wind at Jiezhou uprooted trees. On the xinhai day of the fourth month, a violent wind at Jingning Prefecture uprooted trees. On the nineteenth day of the seventh month of the fifty-sixth year, a storm at Ye County raged for a full day and night and uprooted every large tree. In the fifth month of the fifty-seventh year, a typhoon at Chenghai uprooted trees. In the sixth month, a violent wind at Tangxi uprooted massive trees and destroyed private homes. In the seventh month, violent wind and rain at Rizhao and Huang County raged for a full day and night and uprooted every large tree. In the fifth month of the fifty-eighth year, a violent wind at Qianzhou uprooted trees. In the sixth month, a violent wind at Baodi uprooted trees. On the night of the nineteenth day of the eighth month, a fierce typhoon struck Jieyang; the wind carried phosphorescent fire, and every tree withered; At Chenghai a fierce typhoon likewise raged, toppling private homes and crushing countless men and women. In the first month of the fifty-ninth year, a typhoon at Yangchun damaged the standing grain. In the eighth month of the sixtieth year, a fierce typhoon at Chenghai carried phosphorescent fire and destroyed the city walls. In the fourth month of the sixty-first year, a violent wind at Ganquan uprooted trees. In the fifth month, a violent wind at Qingyun uprooted trees. In the twelfth month, violent wind and rain at Qinzhou collapsed more than twenty zhang of city wall.

雍正元年四月，平鄉大風拔木。 六月，岑溪大風拔木。 冬，武寧大風拔木。 二年二月，陽信、霑化大風，風中帶火。 四年五月，高淳、當塗大風拔木。 六月，濰縣大風雨，壞民舍十二家。 五年七月，鎮海颶風大作，毀縣署大堂。 九年二月，連州大風雨，拔木壞屋。 六月，陽信大風拔木。 十年七月，南彙大風拔木。 八月，海陽大風拔木。 十月，泰州大風拔木。 十一年八月，沂州大風四晝夜。 十二年七月，泰州大風，拔木壞屋。 十三年八月，高淳大風三晝夜。
In the fourth month of the first year of Yongzheng, a violent wind at Pingxiang uprooted trees. In the sixth month, a violent wind at Cenxi uprooted trees. In winter, a violent wind at Wuning uprooted trees. In the second month of the second year of Yongzheng, violent winds at Yangxin and Zhanhua carried fire within them. In the fifth month of the fourth year of Yongzheng, violent winds at Gaochun and Dangtu uprooted trees. In the sixth month, violent wind and rain at Wei County destroyed twelve private homes. In the seventh month of the fifth year of Yongzheng, a fierce typhoon at Zhenhai destroyed the county yamen's main hall. In the second month of the ninth year of Yongzheng, violent wind and rain at Lianzhou uprooted trees and destroyed houses. In the sixth month, a violent wind at Yangxin uprooted trees. In the seventh month of the tenth year of Yongzheng, a violent wind at Nanhui uprooted trees. In the eighth month, a violent wind at Haiyang uprooted trees. In the tenth month, a violent wind at Taizhou uprooted trees. In the eighth month of the eleventh year of Yongzheng, a violent wind at Yizhou raged for four days and nights. In the seventh month of the twelfth year of Yongzheng, a violent wind at Taizhou uprooted trees and destroyed houses. In the eighth month of the thirteenth year of Yongzheng, a violent wind at Gaochun raged for three days and nights.

乾隆元年五月，翼城大風拔木。 二年八月十五日，平陽大風。 三年七月，鍾祥大風拔木。 五年三月，通州大風拔木。 六月，掖縣大風拔木。 六年四月，平定、樂平、孟縣大風拔木。 八年五月，光化大風拔木。 十年三月，棲霞大風拔木。 十一年七月十五日，高郵大風拔木。 十二年七月，昆山、鹽城、清河、福山、棲霞、文登大風，拔木覆屋。 十三年三月，鶴慶大風拔木。 四月，清河大風雨，民舍傾圮無算。 五月，泰州、通州大風拔木。 十四年四月，池州大風拔木。 六月，高邑大風拔木。 十五年三月，武昌暴風起江中，覆舟無數。 六月，武寧大風拔木。 十六年七月，鶴慶大風。 十七年五月十一日，長子縣王婆村大風雷，田禾如爇，屋瓦車輪有飛至數里外者。 十八年六月，潮陽大風拔木。 七月，雞澤大風拔木。 十九年七月，陵川大風害稼。 二十年三月，蘄州大風，壞民舍二百餘間，壓斃十餘人。 五月，高平大風拔木。 七月，昌樂大風拔木。 二十二年六月，吳川颶風，拔木壞屋。 七月，孟縣、樂平大風傷稼。 二十三年六月二十九日，即墨大風，一夜，大木盡拔。 二十四年八月，平定大風害稼。 二十六年三月，潛山大風，拔木壞屋。 二十七年三月十八日，潯州颶風毀城樓。 七月，嘉善大風，拔木壞屋。 二十八年二月，歙縣大風，拔木覆屋，壓斃人畜甚多。 三十年三月，臨邑大風拔木。 三十一年七月，黃縣大風拔木。 三十二年三月，文登、榮成大風拔木。 五月，濟寧州大風拔木。 三十三年二月，安丘大風損麥。 六月十八日，瓊州颶風大作，毀官署民房無算。 三十四年五月，東平大風拔木。 秋，嘉善大風，禾盡偃。 三十五年六月，祁縣大風拔木。 三十六年二月，文登、榮成大風拔木。 三十七年八月十七日，慶雲夜起異風，拔木無算。 三十八年秋，永年、薊州大風雨拔木，熟禾盡偃。 三十九年二月，黃縣、文登、榮成大風連日，麥苗盡損。 七月，滎陽大風拔木。 四十一年，安丘大風蔽日，風內有火光。 四十二年四月，山陽大風拔木。 四十三年二月，光化大風拔木。 四十四年五月，南宮烈風雷雨，樹木多拔。 四十六年六月，金華、嘉善大風拔木。 四十七年六月，新城大風拔木。 四十八年二月，文登、榮成大風拔木。 六月二十四日，吳川颶風大作，壞官署民房及城垣。 四十九年二月，平陰大風拔木。 五十年二月，永昌大風拔木。 五十一年正月，文登、榮成大風拔木。 五十七年七月壬戌，蘇州大風毀民舍。 五十九年七月，桐鄉大風雨竟夜，拔去大成殿前柏二株； 湖州、嘉善大風，拔木壞屋。 六十年六月，石門大風拔木。

On the fifteenth day of the eighth month of the sixteenth year of Guangxu, a violent wind at Guyuan uprooted trees. 順治元年七月，平原狂風晝晦。 二年十月，全椒晝晦。 五年九月，漢陽大風晝晦。 六年四月，莊浪風霾殺禾。 九月，府穀風霾晝晦。 七年十月，東明晝晦。 十二年春，樂亭風霾晝晦。 十三年七月，高邑大風霾晝晦。 八月，邢台風霾。 十四年二月，陽城黃霾蔽天，屋瓦皆飛。 十六年四月朔，萬州晝晦。
In the seventh month of the first year of Shunzhi, a furious wind at Pingyuan turned day to darkness. In the tenth month of the second year, unnatural daytime darkness fell over Quanjiao. 康熙元年正月朔，長興晝晦。 九月，昌黎風霾。 二年正月，蘄州晝晦。 四年正月朔，蕭縣晝晦。 四月辛亥，臨邑晝晦。 七年二月，咸寧晝晦。 十二年七月，樂亭風霾。 十三年二月，咸陽大風霾十餘日。 三月，朝城晝晦。 十四年三月二十六日，冀州起異風，自巳至戌，黃霾蔽天，屋瓦皆飛； 懷安、西寧大風霾晝晦； 玉田大風，揚沙拔木，陰霾竟日。 十五年五月，貴州晝晦如夜。 十六年春，清河風霾四十餘日。 二十三年四月朔，朝城晝晦。 七月望，壁山晝晦。 二十四年正月二十三日，文安大風霾，晝晦如夜； 武邑黑風晝晦。 二十五年二月二十七日，鄆城黑風晝晦。 二十七年四月朔，西寧、龍門、延安、文縣同日晝晦。 二十九年三月十九日，廣宗風霾，紅、黃、黑、白互變。 四月初五日，西寧晝晦。 三十年三月初四日，寧陽大風晝晦。 三十一年正月朔，廣宗晝晦，青州、沛縣、丘縣大風晝晦。 二月朔，丘縣大風赤霾晝晦，廣宗晝晦。 三十二年二月十七日，丘縣大風霾，空中望之如火。 十八日，桐鄉大風霾。 十九日，湖州大風霾。 三十三年四月朔，保安州晝晦。 三十四年四月，肅州晝晦。 三十五年正月，靜樂晝晦。 二月十八日，定陶黑風，觸器有光，行人不辨咫尺。 三十六年三月朔，靖遠晝晦。 三十七年四月，龍門晝晦。 四十二年五月二十二日，鞏縣大風晝晦。 四十四年五月十八日，利津、陽信晝晦。 四十五年正月十二，商河狂風晝晦。 四十七年六月二十五日，涼州晝晦如夜。 四十八年六月，東昌大風霾蔽天。 四十九年三月初七日，中衛晝晦者四日。 六月初二日，什邡晝晦。 五十年五月壬子，諸城晝晦。 五十一年二月癸亥，東平、東阿大風，色紅黑，自申至亥方止； 陽穀黑風晝晦； 郯城、莘縣大風霾。 三月十六日，钜鹿風霾如火，晝晦如夜。 六月十日，恩縣赤霾蔽天，咫尺不辨人物。 十一月二十一日，宿州晝晦。 五十三年二月二十一日，井陘風霾蔽天，晝晦。 五十五年五月，壽光、臨朐大風晝晦。 五十七年五月二十二日，新樂大風晝晦。 五十九年五月二十六日，青城大風晝晦。 六月，太平大風霾。 六十年夏，丘縣大風霾連日。 六十一年七月，元氏、沁州大風霾。
On New Year's Day of the first year of Kangxi, daytime darkness fell over Changxing. In the ninth month, wind-driven haze swept Changli. In the first month of the second year, unnatural daytime darkness fell over Qichun. On the first day of the first month of the fourth year, daytime darkness fell over Xiao County. On the xinhai day of the fourth month, daytime darkness fell over Linyi. In the second month of the seventh year, daytime darkness fell over Xianning. In the seventh month of the twelfth year, wind-driven haze swept Leting. In the second month of the thirteenth year, violent wind and haze at Xianyang persisted for more than ten days. In the third month, daytime darkness fell over Chaocheng. On the twenty-sixth day of the third month of the fourteenth year, an unnatural wind rose at Jizhou; from the si hour to the xu hour, yellow haze blotted out the sky and sent every roof tile flying; at Huai'an and Xining, violent wind and haze brought daytime darkness; at Yutian, a violent wind raised sand and uprooted trees, and murky haze shrouded the land for the entire day. In the fifth month of the fifteenth year, Guizhou was dark as night at midday. In the spring of the sixteenth year, wind-driven haze at Qinghe persisted for more than forty days. On the first day of the fourth month of the twenty-third year, daytime darkness fell over Chaocheng. On the full moon of the seventh month, daytime darkness fell over Bishan. On the twenty-third day of the first month of the twenty-fourth year, violent wind and haze at Wen'an brought a darkness at midday like night; at Wuyi, a black wind brought daytime darkness. On the twenty-seventh day of the second month of the twenty-fifth year, a black wind at Yuncheng darkened the day. On the first day of the fourth month of the twenty-seventh year, Xining, Longmen, Yan'an, and Wen County all suffered daytime darkness on the same day. On the nineteenth day of the third month of the twenty-ninth year, wind-driven haze at Guangzong shifted among red, yellow, black, and white. On the fifth day of the fourth month, daytime darkness fell over Xining. On the fourth day of the third month of the thirtieth year, a violent wind at Ningyang brought daytime darkness. On New Year's Day of the thirty-first year, daytime darkness fell over Guangzong; a violent wind at Qingzhou, Pei County, and Qiu County brought daytime darkness. On the first day of the second month, a violent wind and red haze at Qiu County darkened the day, and Guangzong again suffered daytime darkness. On the seventeenth day of the second month of the thirty-second year, violent wind and haze at Qiu County made the sky above look like fire. On the eighteenth day, violent wind and haze swept Tongxiang. On the nineteenth day, violent wind and haze swept Huzhou. On the first day of the fourth month of the thirty-third year, daytime darkness fell over Bao'an Prefecture. In the fourth month of the thirty-fourth year, daytime darkness fell over Suzhou Prefecture. In the first month of the thirty-fifth year, daytime darkness fell over Jingle. On the eighteenth day of the second month, a black wind at Dingtao made objects spark on contact, and travelers could not make out anything an arm's length away. On the first day of the third month of the thirty-sixth year, daytime darkness fell over Jingyuan. In the fourth month of the thirty-seventh year, daytime darkness fell over Longmen. On the twenty-second day of the fifth month of the forty-second year, a violent wind at Gong County brought daytime darkness. On the eighteenth day of the fifth month of the forty-fourth year, daytime darkness fell over Lijin and Yangxin. On the twelfth day of the first month of the forty-fifth year, a furious wind at Shanghe brought daytime darkness. On the twenty-fifth day of the sixth month of the forty-seventh year, Liangzhou was dark as night at midday. In the sixth month of the forty-eighth year, violent wind and haze at Dongchang blotted out the sky. On the seventh day of the third month of the forty-ninth year, Zhongwei suffered daytime darkness for four days. On the second day of the sixth month, daytime darkness fell over Shifang. On the renzi day of the fifth month of the fiftieth year, daytime darkness fell over Zhucheng. On the guihai day of the second month of the fifty-first year, violent winds at Dongping and Dong'e blew red and black; from the shen hour to the hai hour they finally abated; at Yanggu, a black wind brought daytime darkness; at Tancheng and Shen County, violent wind and haze swept the land. On the sixteenth day of the third month, wind-driven haze at Julu looked like fire, and the day was dark as night. On the tenth day of the sixth month, red haze at En County blotted out the sky, and one could not make out a person an arm's length away. On the twenty-first day of the eleventh month, daytime darkness fell over Suzhou. On the twenty-first day of the second month of the fifty-third year, wind-driven haze at Jingxing blotted out the sky and darkened the day. In the fifth month of the fifty-fifth year, violent winds at Shouguang and Linqu brought daytime darkness. On the twenty-second day of the fifth month of the fifty-seventh year, a violent wind at Xinle brought daytime darkness. On the twenty-sixth day of the fifth month of the fifty-ninth year, a violent wind at Qingcheng brought daytime darkness. In the sixth month, violent wind and haze swept Taiping. In the summer of the sixtieth year, violent wind and haze at Qiu County persisted day after day. In the seventh month of the sixty-first year, violent wind and haze swept Yuanshi and Qin Prefecture.

雍正元年三月，青州風霾。 四月初七日，獻縣風霾晝晦； 恩縣夜起大風，飛石拔木，有頃黑霾如墨，良久復變為紅霾，乍明乍暗，逮曉方息； 泰安大風霾晝晦。 十一日，高密、高苑大風霾晝晦。 十七日，邢台、元氏大風霾拔木。 八月初八日，掖縣大風霾晝晦。 二年二月初六日，元氏大風霾。 八年正月十一日，高苑大風霾晝晦。
In the third month of the first year of Yongzheng, wind-driven haze swept Qingzhou. On the seventh day of the fourth month, wind and haze at Xian County brought daytime darkness; at En County a violent wind rose at night, hurling stones and uprooting trees; soon black haze thick as ink descended, then shifted to red haze, flickering between light and dark until dawn before it finally abated; at Tai'an, violent wind and haze brought daytime darkness. On the eleventh day, violent wind and haze at Gaomi and Gaoyuan darkened the day. On the seventeenth day, violent wind and haze at Xingtai and Yuanshi uprooted trees. On the eighth day of the eighth month, violent wind and haze at Ye County brought daytime darkness. On the sixth day of the second month of the second year, violent wind and haze swept Yuanshi. On the eleventh day of the first month of the eighth year, violent wind and haze at Gaoyuan darkened the day.

In the winter of the seventeenth year, peonies blossomed at Tangshan.

康熙二年十月，通州桃李華。 四年十二月，德清吉祥寺牡丹開數莖。 六年冬，寧津桃李華。 七年秋，肥鄉桃李華。 八年十一月，西充桃李華。 十年八月，唐山海棠華，高邑丁香華。 十一年九月，湖州桃李華。 十七年十月，陽高桃李華。 二十六年八月，新城桃李海棠華。 三十年冬，潛江桃李華。 三十六年七月，孟縣、平定桃李華。 三十八年三月，石阡府學宮桂再華。 四十三年冬，曲沃桃杏華。 四十六年十月，瓊州海棠再華。 五十四年冬，蒲台李華。 五十六年十月，寧津牡丹華。 六十年冬，揭陽桃李華。
In the tenth month of the second year of Kangxi, peach and plum trees blossomed at Tongzhou. In the twelfth month of the fourth year, several stalks of peony opened at Jixiang Temple in Deqing. In the winter of the sixth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Ningjin. In the autumn of the seventh year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Feixiang. In the eleventh month of the eighth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Xichong. In the eighth month of the tenth year, crab apple blossomed at Tangshan, and lilac blossomed at Gaoyi. In the ninth month of the eleventh year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Huzhou. In the tenth month of the seventeenth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Yanggao. In the eighth month of the twenty-sixth year, peach, plum, and crab apple blossomed at Xincheng. In the winter of the thirtieth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Qianjiang. In the seventh month of the thirty-sixth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Meng County and Pingding. In the third month of the thirty-eighth year, osmanthus at the Shiqian Prefecture Confucian school blossomed again. In the winter of the forty-third year, peach and apricot blossomed at Quwo. In the tenth month of the forty-sixth year, crab apple at Qiongzhou blossomed again. In the winter of the fifty-fourth year, plum trees blossomed at Putai. In the tenth month of the fifty-sixth year, peonies blossomed at Ningjin. In the winter of the sixtieth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Jieyang.
29
雍正三年冬，順德桃李華。 八年冬，通州桃李華。 九年冬，高淳桃李華。 十年八月，通州桃李華。 十三年七月，清河李再華。
In the winter of the third year of Yongzheng, peach and plum trees blossomed at Shunde. In the winter of the eighth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Tongzhou. In the winter of the ninth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Gaochun. In the eighth month of the tenth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Tongzhou. In the seventh month of the thirteenth year, plum trees at Qinghe blossomed again.
30
乾隆三年秋，曲沃桃李華。 七年冬至日，崇明牡丹開。 九年冬，桐鄉桃李華。 十年八月，寧津桃李華。 十三年五月，玉屏梅花盛開。 十四年八月，鎮海杏再華。 十六年九月，分宜高林寺牡丹開。 十八年九月，新安縣署牡丹開花一朵，十月又開十朵，曆月不萎。 九月，太原桃李華。 二十年春，普安州桂花盛開。 二十四年九月，潞安桃李華。 三十年九月，高邑桃李華。 三十三年九月，和順桃李華。 四十三年九月，新城桃李華。 冬，石門桃李華。 四十六年九月，臨邑桃李華。 四十九年十月，桐鄉鳳鳴寺牡丹開二花，單瓣紫色。 十一月，金華桃李華。 五十年秋，通州杏再華。 六十年十二月，樂清桃李華。
In the autumn of the third year of Qianlong, peach and plum trees blossomed at Quwo. On the winter solstice of the seventh year, peonies opened at Chongming. In the winter of the ninth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Tongxiang. In the eighth month of the tenth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Ningjin. In the fifth month of the thirteenth year, plum blossoms opened profusely at Yuping. In the eighth month of the fourteenth year, apricot at Zhenhai blossomed again. In the ninth month of the sixteenth year, peonies opened at Gaolin Temple in Fenyi. In the ninth month of the eighteenth year, a single peony bloomed at the Xin'an county magistrate's yamen; in the tenth month ten more blossoms opened and did not wither for a month. In the ninth month, peach and plum trees blossomed at Taiyuan. In the spring of the twentieth year, osmanthus bloomed profusely at Pu'an Prefecture. In the ninth month of the twenty-fourth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Lu'an. In the ninth month of the thirtieth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Gaoyi. In the ninth month of the thirty-third year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Heshun. In the ninth month of the forty-third year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Xincheng. In the winter, peach and plum trees blossomed at Shimen. In the ninth month of the forty-sixth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Linyi. In the tenth month of the forty-ninth year, two single-petaled purple peonies opened at Fengming Temple in Tongxiang. In the eleventh month, peach and plum trees blossomed at Jinhua. In the autumn of the fiftieth year, apricot at Tongzhou blossomed again. In the twelfth month of the sixtieth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Yueqing.
31
嘉慶四年九月，邢台桃李華。 六年八月，陸川桃李華。
In the ninth month of the fourth year of Jiaqing, peach and plum trees blossomed at Xingtai. In the eighth month of the sixth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Luchuan.
32
道光三年九月，興國桃花盛開。 九年十月，宜城桃李華。 十七年冬，望都、清苑桃杏華。 二十二年十月，崇陽桃李華。 二十四年九月，滕縣桃李華。 二十五年十月，鍾祥桃再華。 二十九年秋，餘姚桃花盛開。 三十年九月，竹山桃李牡丹華。
In the ninth month of the third year of Daoguang, peach trees at Xingguo blossomed profusely. In the tenth month of the ninth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Yicheng. In the winter of the seventeenth year, peach and apricot blossomed at Wangdu and Qingyuan. In the tenth month of the twenty-second year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Chongyang. In the ninth month of the twenty-fourth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Teng County. In the tenth month of the twenty-fifth year, peach trees at Zhongxiang blossomed again. In the autumn of the twenty-ninth year, peach trees at Yuyao blossomed profusely. In the ninth month of the thirtieth year, peach, plum, and peony blossomed at Zhushan.
33
咸豐元年秋，貴溪桃李華。 十月，鄖縣桃李華。 四年冬，鬆滋桃李華。 五年十一月，武昌桃李華。 九年秋，崇陽桃再華。 十月，宜昌桃李華。 十年九月，嘉興桃李華。 十一月，麻城桃再華。
In the autumn of the first year of Xianfeng, peach and plum trees blossomed at Guixi. In the tenth month, peach and plum trees blossomed at Yun County. In the winter of the fourth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Songzi. In the eleventh month of the fifth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Wuchang. In the autumn of the ninth year, peach trees at Chongyang blossomed again. In the tenth month, peach and plum trees blossomed at Yichang. In the ninth month of the tenth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Jiaxing. In the eleventh month, peach trees at Macheng blossomed again.
34
同治元年十月，襄陽桃李華。 二年冬，通州桃李華。 四年冬，房縣桃李華。 八年冬，黃安桃再華。 十二年九月，惠民桃李華。
In the tenth month of the first year of Tongzhi, peach and plum trees blossomed at Xiangyang. In the winter of the second year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Tongzhou. In the winter of the fourth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Fang County. In the winter of the eighth year, peach trees at Huang'an blossomed again. In the ninth month of the twelfth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Huimin.
35
光緒元年十一月，莊浪桃杏華。 四年冬，武昌、光化桃李華。 五年冬至時，高淳群花齊放，宛如春色。 六年七月，歸州桃李華。 九月，蒼溪桃再華。 九年冬，興山桃李華。 十二年九月，南樂杏再華。 二十四年十月，南樂桃李華。 三十二年秋，靖遠桃李華。 三十四年八月，固原桃李華。
In the eleventh month of the first year of Guangxu, peach and apricot blossomed at Zhuanglang. In the winter of the fourth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Wuchang and Guanghua. At the winter solstice of the fifth year, flowers of every kind opened together at Gaochun, as though spring had returned. In the seventh month of the sixth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Guizhou. In the ninth month, peach trees at Cangxi blossomed again. In the winter of the ninth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Xingshan. In the ninth month of the twelfth year, apricot trees at Nanle blossomed again. In the tenth month of the twenty-fourth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Nanle. In the autumn of the thirty-second year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Jingyuan. In the eighth month of the thirty-fourth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Guyuan.
36
順治十七年八月，玉屏黑蟲蔽山，草木皆盡。
In the eighth month of the seventeenth year of Shunzhi, black insects at Yuping swarmed over the mountains and stripped the land bare of vegetation.
37
康熙十年秋，潮州蟲生五色，大如指，長三寸，食稼。 十一年七月，杭州雨蟲，食穗。 十二年七月，萬載蟲食禾。 十三年三月，寧都屋上有生黑蟲者，著人甚痛。 十七年七月，崇明出兩頭蟲，首尾皆喙，齧草如刈。 十九年六月，婺源青蟲害稼。 二十年二月，鄖陽蟲災。 二十一年五月，金華蟲災。 二十二年四月，恩施蟲災。 二十三年五月，渠縣有蟲數萬斛，似蝗，黑色，頭銳，有翅，嗅之甚臭。 二十七年七月，蘇州、青浦蟲災。 二十九年四月，沁水白黑蟲食禾，結繭。 三十年三月，萬載青蟲食禾。 三十六年，遵化州生蟲，似槐蟲而黑，食稼幾盡。 三十九年，貴縣生蟲，食豆。 四十二年，昭化有蟲如蠶，食禾。 四十五年二月，房縣蟲食禾。 夏，霑化有蟲似螳螂而金色，識者曰，此蒼諸也，見則歲凶。 四十九年五月，井陘五色蟲生。 五十六年，鶴慶蟲食禾。 五十七年夏，新樂生蟲，青色，傷禾。
In the autumn of the tenth year of Kangxi, Chaozhou was infested with five-colored insects as large as a finger and three inches long, which devoured the standing grain. In the seventh month of the eleventh year, insects rained down on Hangzhou and devoured the grain ears. In the seventh month of the twelfth year, insects at Wanzi devoured the standing grain. In the third month of the thirteenth year, black insects appeared on rooftops at Ningdu, and contact with them caused intense pain. In the seventh month of the seventeenth year, Chongming was beset by two-headed insects with beaks at both ends that gnawed the grass as if a scythe had passed over it. In the sixth month of the nineteenth year, green insects at Wuyuan damaged the standing grain. In the second month of the twentieth year, Yunyang suffered an insect plague. In the fifth month of the twenty-first year, Jinhua suffered an insect plague. In the fourth month of the twenty-second year, Enshi suffered an insect plague. In the fifth month of the twenty-third year, Quxian was overrun by insects numbering in the tens of thousands of hu—locust-like, black, sharp-headed, and winged, and foul-smelling beyond measure. In the seventh month of the twenty-seventh year, Suzhou and Qingpu suffered an insect plague. In the fourth month of the twenty-ninth year, white and black insects at Qinshui devoured the grain and spun cocoons. In the third month of the thirtieth year, green insects at Wanzi devoured the standing grain. In the thirty-sixth year, Zunhua Prefecture was infested with black insects resembling locust-tree worms that nearly devoured the entire harvest. In the thirty-ninth year, insects at Guixian devoured the bean crop. In the forty-second year, silkworm-like insects at Zhaohua devoured the standing grain. In the second month of the forty-fifth year, insects at Fang County devoured the standing grain. That summer, Zhanhua was visited by golden, mantis-like insects that the learned identified as cangzhu—creatures whose appearance presaged a year of famine. In the fifth month of the forty-ninth year, five-colored insects appeared at Jingxing. In the fifty-sixth year, insects at Heqing devoured the standing grain. In the summer of the fifty-seventh year, green insects at Xinle damaged the standing grain.
38
雍正二年七月，鎮海麥莖生蟲，頭紅身黑，狀如蠶。 十年秋，清河禾生蟲，形似蛆，有毛，紅色。
In the seventh month of the second year of Yongzheng, wheat stalks at Zhenhai sprouted red-headed, black-bodied worms shaped like silkworms. In the autumn of the tenth year, the grain at Qinghe was afflicted with hairy red maggot-like insects.
39
乾隆十七年八月，仁和蟲食稼。 二十年春，臨安蟲災。 二十一年六月，景寧有白蟲無數自南來。 二十三年秋，海寧雨蠶。 二十四年八月，武邑有乚蟲食禾根。 三十年十月，嘉興蟲災。 三十八年春，青浦河水生蟲，色紅，狀如蜈蚣，長三四寸，昏暮始見。 六十年正月，平度蟲災。
In the eighth month of the seventeenth year of Qianlong, insects at Renhe devoured the standing grain. In the spring of the twentieth year, Lin'an suffered an insect plague. In the sixth month of the twenty-first year, countless white insects swept into Jingning from the south. In the autumn of the twenty-third year, silkworms rained down on Haining. In the eighth month of the twenty-fourth year, worms at Wuyi devoured the roots of the standing grain. In the tenth month of the thirtieth year, Jiaxing suffered an insect plague. In the spring of the thirty-eighth year, red centipede-like insects three or four inches long appeared in the river at Qingpu, visible only at dusk. In the first month of the sixtieth year, Pingdu suffered an insect plague.
40
嘉慶九年夏，洛川蟲傷禾。 道光五年七月，滕縣生五色蟲，食禾殆盡。
In the summer of the ninth year of Jiaqing, insects at Luochuan damaged the standing grain. In the seventh month of the fifth year of Daoguang, five-colored insects at Teng County nearly devoured the entire harvest.
41
咸豐元年六月，崇陽蟲災。 九年五月，蘇州禾田中出蟲，名曰稻鱉。
In the sixth month of the first year of Xianfeng, Chongyang suffered an insect plague. In the fifth month of the ninth year, insects called daobie appeared in the rice fields at Suzhou.
42
同治四年秋，秀水有青蟲如蠶，喙黑，卷葉作網。 十三年九月，嘉興田禾生蟲，食根，似黑蟻，蜂腰，六足，有須。 光緒二年八月，寧津蟲傷稼。 十四年春，泰安蟲災。
In the autumn of the fourth year of Tongzhi, Xiushui was plagued by green silkworm-like insects with black mouthparts that rolled leaves into webs. In the ninth month of the thirteenth year, root-eating insects appeared in the grain fields at Jiaxing—black-ant-like creatures with pinched waists, six legs, and antennae. In the eighth month of the second year of Guangxu, insects at Ningjin damaged the standing grain. In the spring of the fourteenth year, Tai'an suffered an insect plague.
43
順治元年二月，萊陽民家牛產犢，一體二首。 二年二月，交城民家牛產一犢，遍體鱗甲。 十年，文縣民家牛產兩麟。 十六年，定州民家牛產麟。
In the second month of the first year of Shunzhi, a farmer's ox at Laiyang bore a calf with one body and two heads. In the second month of the second year, a farmer's ox at Jiaocheng bore a calf covered from head to tail in scales. In the tenth year, a farmer's ox at Wen County bore two qilin. In the sixteenth year, a farmer's ox at Dingzhou bore a qilin.
44
康熙五年，南昌民家牛產麟。 十三年七月，巫山民家牛產一犢，三目四耳，舌端有鈌，胸列四蹄，脊後分為二身，各二蹄一尾。 十五年，池州民家牛產犢，二首八足。 十七年六月，鎮洋民家牛產犢，兩頭。 二十八年九月，餘姚北鄉民家牛產麟，狼項、馬足、麕身，遍體鱗甲，金紫相錯。 三十八年，景寧民家牛產麟。
In the fifth year of Kangxi, a farmer's ox at Nanchang bore a qilin. In the seventh month of the thirteenth year, a farmer's ox at Wushan bore a calf with three eyes and four ears, a hook at the tip of its tongue, four hooves on its chest, and a spine that divided into two bodies, each with two hooves and a tail. In the fifteenth year, a farmer's ox at Chizhou bore a calf with two heads and eight legs. In the sixth month of the seventeenth year, a farmer's ox at Zhenyang bore a two-headed calf. In the ninth month of the twenty-eighth year, a farmer's ox in northern Yuyao bore a qilin with a wolf's neck, horse's legs, and a deer-like body, its hide entirely scaly in mingled gold and purple. In the thirty-eighth year, a farmer's ox at Jingning bore a qilin.
45
雍正七年，鎮海民家牛生一犢，遍體鱗紋，色青黑，頷下有髯，項皆細鱗。 十一年五月，鹽亭民家牛產一麟，高二尺五寸，肉角一，長寸許，目如水晶，鱗甲遍體，兩脊傍至尾各有肉粒如豆，黃金色，麕身，八足，牛蹄，產時風雨交至，金光滿院，射草木皆黃。 十三年二月，綿州民家牛產一犢，首形如龍，身有鱗紋，無毛，落地而殤。
In the seventh year of Yongzheng, a farmer's ox at Zhenhai bore a calf covered in blue-black scales, bearded beneath the jaw and fine-scaled along the neck. In the fifth month of the eleventh year, a farmer's ox at Yanting bore a qilin two feet five inches tall, with a fleshy horn an inch long, crystal-clear eyes, and scales from head to tail studded with golden bean-sized nodules along the spine; deer-bodied and eight-legged with ox hooves, it was born amid driving wind and rain as golden light flooded the courtyard and turned grass and trees yellow in its glow. In the second month of the thirteenth year, a farmer's ox at Mianzhou bore a hairless, dragon-headed calf covered in scale patterns; it died the moment it touched the ground.
46
乾隆四年，盛京民家牛產麟。 五年，壽州民家牛產麟，一室火光，眾以為怪，格殺之，剝皮，見周身鱗甲，頭角猶隱ю也； 荊州民家牛產麟，遍體鱗甲。 二十二年，崇明見三足牛，前一後二。
In the fourth year of Qianlong, a farmer's ox at Shengjing bore a qilin. In the fifth year, a farmer's ox at Shouzhou bore a qilin amid a blaze of light that filled the room; the crowd, deeming it monstrous, killed it, and when the hide was stripped away, scales covered its entire body and the head and horns were still faintly visible; A farmer's ox at Jingzhou bore a qilin covered from head to tail in scales. In the twenty-second year, a three-legged ox was sighted at Chongming, with one foreleg and two hind legs.
47
嘉慶元年，遂安民家牛產麟。 二年，平度州民家牛產麟。 五年，白河縣民家牛產一犢，兩首雙項，剖腹視之，心赤有二。 道光十二年，永嘉民家牛產犢，兩首。
In the first year of Jiaqing, a farmer's ox at Suian bore a qilin. In the second year, a farmer's ox at Pingdu Prefecture bore a qilin. In the fifth year, a farmer's ox at Baihe County bore a two-headed calf with double necks; when the belly was opened, two red hearts were found within. In the twelfth year of Daoguang, a farmer's ox at Yongjia bore a two-headed calf.
48
咸豐二年，潛江民家牛產犢，兩首。 七年，黃岩民家牛產犢，四首。 同治九年，莘縣民家牛產犢，兩首。
In the second year of Xianfeng, a farmer's ox at Qianjiang bore a two-headed calf. In the seventh year, a farmer's ox at Huangyan bore a four-headed calf. In the ninth year of Tongzhi, a farmer's ox at Shen County bore a two-headed calf.
49
光緒十九年，太平民家牛產麟。 七年，京山民家牛產犢，三足，前二後一，識之者謂之豲。 三十四年，皋蘭民家牛產犢，兩首。
In the nineteenth year of Guangxu, a farmer's ox at Taiping bore a qilin. In the seventh year, a farmer's ox at Jingshan bore a three-legged calf, with two forelegs and one hind leg, which the knowledgeable identified as a yuan. In the thirty-fourth year, a farmer's ox at Gaolan bore a two-headed calf.
50
順治元年九月，翼城地震。 冬，石首地震。 二十二年，祁縣地震三次。 三年十月十日，石埭地震。 四年四月，全椒地震。 五年三月甲辰，涇陽、三原、臨潼、鳳翔地震； 戊辰又地震。 四月二十四日，榆社地震。 八月，潞安地震有聲。 六年正月，南樂地震。 二月初六日，陸川地震。 四月，高平、陽城地震。 七年八月初十日，高淳地震。 八年正月丁卯，蘇州、昆山地震。 六月，高平地震。 九年正月元旦，潛江、太湖地震。 十五日，貴池地震，屋瓦皆飛，江波如蕩。 二月十五日，池州、潁上、阜陽、五河、全椒地震。 二十四日，宿鬆地震。 二十六日，銅陵地震。 七月，贛榆地震。 九月，霍山、六安地震。 十年正月，廬江地震。 六月乙卯，鎮洋地震。 七月，海豐地震。 九月，樂陵地震。 十月二十一日，貴池地震； 二十四日復震。 十一月二十三日，五河地震。 十一年正月朔，潛山、望江、石樓、貴池、銅陵、舒城、廬江地震。 五月，廬江又震。 四月初六日，蕭山地震。 五月初八日，寶雞、定遠、沔縣地震，壞屋壓人。 六月，興安、安康、白河、紫陽、洵陽、蘭州、鞏昌、慶陽等處地震，聲如雷，壞民舍，壓死人畜甚眾。 八月初五日，陽穀、東昌地震，次日又震。 初八日辰刻，朝城地震，申刻復震。 十二年正月初七日，陽湖、營山地震。 二月庚申，昆山、婁縣地震。 十三年三月初八日，中部地震。 十四年三月朔，成都、威州、汶川地震。 二十五日，西充地震，次日復震。 七月，富陽地震。 十五年二月二十四日，惠來地震。 五月二十三日，武進地震。 八月二十三日，蘇州、昆山、上海、青浦地震。 十一月，安塞地震有聲。 十六年正月二十八日，鎮平地震。 二月初八日，揭陽地震。 七月十七日，石埭、貴池地震，聲如雷。 十七年八月，曹縣、兗州地震。 十二月二十三日，雒南、商南地震。 十八年正月，兗州地屢震。

On the fifth day of the eighth month, Yanggu and Dongchang were shaken by earthquake, and the ground shook again the next day. On the twenty-fourth day of the second month of the fifteenth year, Huilai was shaken by earthquake. On the twenty-third day of the fifth month, Wujin was shaken by earthquake. On the twenty-third day of the eighth month, an earthquake struck Suzhou, Kunshan, Shanghai, and Qingpu. In the eleventh month, an audible earthquake struck Ansai. On the twenty-eighth day of the first month of the sixteenth year, Zhenping was shaken by earthquake. On the eighth day of the second month, Jieyang was shaken by earthquake. On the seventeenth day of the seventh month, Shidi and Guichi were shaken by earthquake with a sound like thunder. In the eighth month of the seventeenth year, an earthquake struck Caoxian and Yanzhou. On the twenty-third day of the twelfth month, an earthquake struck Luonan and Shangnan. 康熙元年正月二十五日，伏羌地震。 三月初四日，西寧、龍門、宣化、赤城、保安州等處地大震，人皆眩仆。 六月十七日，太平地震。 七月十一日，蒼梧、容縣、岑溪地震。 十一月二十二日，威縣地震。 二年正月二十五日，鍾祥地震，次日復震。 五月二十一日，咸寧地震。 六月望日，東安地震。 十二月，鶴慶地震。 三年三月初二日，保安州、龍門地震。 初三日，懷來、灤州地震。 五月，開平地震。 八月十七日，萊陽地震。 二十三日，安邑、解州地震。 九月丙子，昆山地震。 十一月二十一日，順德地震。 四年二月初四日，平陰地震。 三月初二日，京師地震有聲。 初四日，景州地震。 四月十五日，灤州、東安、昌平、順義地震二次，房垣皆傾。 七月十七日，大城地震。 五年二月二十二日，開平地震，次日又震。 三月初八日，交河地震。 七月十七日，虹縣地震，城傾數十丈，民舍悉壞。 九月二十六日，揭陽地震。 十二月丁未，蘇州地震。 六年正月初四日，陽春地震。 四月十二日，揭陽地震。 六月十七日，慶雲地震。 八月十四日，邢台、內丘地震，聲如雷。 九月二十三日，永年、威縣地震。 七年四月，金華地震。 五月癸丑子時，京師地震； 初七、初九、初十、十三又震。 六月十七日，上海、海鹽地震，窗廊皆鳴； 湖州、紹興地震，壓斃人畜，次日又震； 桐鄉、嵊縣地震，屋瓦皆落。 十八日，香河、無極、南樂地震，自西北起，戛戛有聲，房屋搖動。 十九日，清河、德清地震有聲，房舍皆傾。 七月二十日，錢塘地震。 二十五日，潛江地震。 八年九月甲午寅時，京師地震有聲。 九年四月初六日，安縣地震。 五月初七日，揭陽地震。 七月己未，吳江、震澤地震有聲。 八月初七日，開建、安丘地震。 十一月冬至前一日，鄒縣地震。

In the spring of the fifty-first year, great famine across Shandong drove people to cannibalism. Famine struck Linyu in the fifty-second year. Famine struck Wendeng and Rongcheng in the fifty-third year. Famine struck Yidu in the fifty-fourth year. Famine struck Yucheng in the fifty-fifth year. In the fifty-sixth year, famine struck Xingtai and eight other counties. In the fifty-seventh year, famine at Tangshan, Ningjin, Wuqiang, and Pingxiang left many people dead of starvation. Famine struck Changshan in the fifty-eighth year. Famine struck Qingyuan, Wangdu, and Li County in the fifty-ninth year. Famine struck Penglai, Huang County, and Qixia in the sixtieth year. That summer, Macheng suffered famine.
85
嘉慶五年夏，海陽饑。 六年，文登、榮成饑。 七年冬，樂亭饑。 八年夏，秦州各屬大饑。 九年春，滕縣饑。 十年夏，黃縣、邢台饑。 十一年春，中部、通渭饑。 冬，安陸饑。 十二年，薊州、昌黎、永安州饑。 十三年夏，黃縣饑。 十五年秋，寧津、東光、章丘饑。 十六年夏，霸州、保定、文安、大城、固安、永清、東安、宛平、涿州、良鄉、雄縣、安州、新安、任丘、灤州、薊州饑。 十七年春，登州府屬大饑，秦州各屬及鎮番、永昌等處大饑。 夏，臨榆饑。 冬，樂清饑。 十八年春，肥城、東阿、滕縣、濟寧、曹縣、諸城饑。 冬，宜城、房縣、竹溪、均州、保康饑。 十九年春，宜城、安陸、保康、麻城、鄖縣饑。 夏，襄陽、漢陽、棗陽、南漳饑。 秋，高淳饑。 二十年，清苑饑。 二十一年，武昌縣饑。 二十二年，固安、武強、內丘饑。 二十五年秋，樂清、永嘉饑。
Haiyang was stricken with famine. Famine struck Wendeng and Rongcheng in the sixth year. Famine struck Laoting in the seventh year. Famine struck the subordinate districts of Qinzhou in the eighth year. Famine struck Teng County in the ninth year. Famine struck Huang County and Xingtai in the tenth year. Famine struck Zhongbu and Tongwei in the eleventh year. That winter, Anlu suffered famine. In the twelfth year, famine struck Jizhou, Changli, and Yong'an Prefecture. Famine struck Huang County in the thirteenth year. Famine struck Ningjin, Dongguang, and Zhangqiu in the fifteenth year. In the summer of the sixteenth year, famine struck Bazhou, Baoding, Wen'an, Dacheng, Gu'an, Yongqing, Dong'an, Wanping, Zhuozhou, Liangxiang, Xiong County, An Prefecture, Xin'an, Renqiu, Luanzhou, and Jizhou. In the spring of the seventeenth year, severe famine struck the districts of Dengzhou Prefecture, while the subordinate districts of Qinzhou together with Zhenfan, Yongchang, and other places were also ravaged by great famine. That summer, Linyu suffered famine. That winter, Yueqing suffered famine. Famine struck Feicheng, Dong'e, Teng County, Jining, Cao County, and Zhucheng in the eighteenth year. That winter, Yicheng, Fang County, Zhuxi, Jun Prefecture, and Baokang suffered famine. Famine struck Yicheng, Anlu, Baokang, Macheng, and Yun County in the nineteenth year. That summer, Xiangyang, Hanyang, Zaoyang, and Nanzhang suffered famine. That autumn, Gaochun suffered famine. Famine struck Qingyuan in the twentieth year. In the twenty-first year. Famine struck Gu'an, Wuqiang, and Neiqiu in the twenty-second year. Famine struck Yueqing and Yongjia in the twenty-fifth year.
86
道光元年秋，榮成饑。 二年夏，灤州饑。 三年春，東阿饑。 秋，曲陽饑。 四年，皋蘭、靜寧、西寧、鞏昌、秦州等處大饑。 五年秋，南樂、靜海、文安、大城、寶坻饑。 七年春，日照大饑。 八年，太平饑。 十年冬，江陵饑。 十二年春，昌平饑。 夏，紫陽大饑，人相食。 冬，鍾祥、潛江、漢城、蘄川、黃梅、江陵、公安、監利、鬆滋饑。 十三年春，諸城、日照大饑，民流亡。 夏，保康、鄖縣、房縣饑，人相食。 秋，灤州、撫寧饑。 十四年春，歸州、興山大饑，人相食。 夏，莊浪及秦州各屬饑。 秋，青浦饑。 冬，定海饑。 十五年春，諸城饑。 秋，孝義廳大饑。 十六年春，登州府屬大饑。 冬，太平饑。 十七年冬，即墨饑。 十八年夏，永年饑。 二十年冬，灤州、樂亭、撫寧饑。 二十一年夏，高淳饑。 冬，枝江饑。 二十二年冬，蘄州饑。 二十三年秋，湖州饑。 二十六年秋，平涼縣饑。 二十七年，南樂饑，人相食。 二十九年夏，江陵、公安、石首、鬆滋、枝江、宜都大饑，餓死者無算。 冬，青浦饑。 三十年春，湖州、咸寧、崇陽饑。
During the first year of the Daoguang reign, Rongcheng suffered famine. Famine struck Luanzhou in the second year. Famine struck Dong'e in the third year. That autumn, Quyang suffered famine. Famine struck Gaolan, Jingning, Xining, Gongchang, and Qinzhou and other places in the fourth year. Famine struck Nanle, Jinghai, Wen'an, Dacheng, and Baodi in the fifth year. Famine struck Rizhao in the seventh year. Famine struck Taiping in the eighth year. Famine struck Jiangling in the tenth year. Famine struck Changping in the twelfth year. That summer, great famine at Ziyang drove people to cannibalism. That winter, Zhongxiang, Qianjiang, Hancheng, Qichuan, Huangmei, Jiangling, Gong'an, Jianli, and Songzi suffered famine. In the spring of the thirteenth year, great famine at Zhucheng and Rizhao drove the people into exile. That summer, famine at Baokang, Yun County, and Fang County drove people to cannibalism. That autumn, Luanzhou and Funing suffered famine. In the spring, great famine at Guizhou Prefecture and Xingshan drove people to cannibalism. That summer, Zhuanglang and the subordinate districts of Qinzhou suffered famine. That autumn, Qingpu suffered famine. That winter, Dinghai suffered famine. Famine struck Zhucheng in the fifteenth year. That autumn, Xiaoyi Subprefecture suffered severe famine. Famine struck the districts of Dengzhou Prefecture in the sixteenth year. That winter, Taiping suffered famine. Famine struck Jimo in the seventeenth year. Famine struck Yongnian in the eighteenth year. Famine struck Luanzhou, Laoting, and Funing in the twentieth year. Famine struck Gaochun in the twenty-first year. That winter, Zhijiang suffered famine. Famine struck Qizhou in the twenty-second year. Famine struck Huzhou in the twenty-third year. Famine struck Pingliang County in the twenty-sixth year. In the twenty-seventh year, famine at Nanle drove people to cannibalism. That summer, great famine at Jiangling, Gong'an, Shishou, Songzi, Zhijiang, and Yidu left untold thousands dead of starvation. That winter, Qingpu suffered famine. Famine struck Huzhou, Xian'ning, and Chongyang in the thirtieth year.
87
咸豐二年春，日照大饑。 夏，全縣大饑。 六年，黃縣、臨朐饑。 七年春，肥城、東平大饑，死者枕藉； 魚台、日照、臨朐亦饑，人相食。 夏，清苑、元氏、無極、邢台大饑。 八年秋，興山饑。
Rizhao suffered severe famine. That summer, Quan County suffered severe famine. Famine struck Huang County and Linqu in the sixth year. In the spring, great famine at Feicheng and Dongping left the dead piled in the streets; Yutai, Rizhao, and Linqu were also stricken with famine, and people resorted to cannibalism. That summer, Qingyuan, Yuanshi, Wuji, and Xingtai suffered severe famine. Famine struck Xingshan in the eighth year.
88
同治元年春，樂亭饑。 二年春，孝義廳饑。 秋，江山、常山饑。 三年，保康饑。 四年春，蘄水饑，民有鬻子女者。 五年，蘭州饑，人相食。 六年春，莊浪、金縣、皋蘭饑。 七年春，即墨、孝義廳、藍田、沔縣饑。 夏，涇州大饑，人相食。 冬，平涼、靜寧、古浪、固原、靈台、秦州、永昌等處大饑。 八年春，日照饑。 九年夏，上饒饑。 十年秋，望都、樂亭饑。 十三年秋，雄縣饑。 冬，山丹饑。
During the first year of the Tongzhi reign, Laoting suffered famine. Famine struck Xiaoyi Subprefecture in the second year. That autumn, Jiangshan and Changshan suffered famine. Famine struck Baokang in the third year. Famine struck Qishui in the fourth year; and people sold their children. In the fifth year, famine at Lanzhou drove people to cannibalism. Famine struck Zhuanglang, Jin County, and Gaolan in the sixth year. Famine struck Jimo, Xiaoyi Subprefecture, Lantian, and Mian County in the seventh year. That summer, great famine at Jingzhou drove people to cannibalism. That winter, severe famine struck Pingliang, Jingning, Gulang, Guyuan, Lingtai, Qinzhou, Yongchang, and other places. Famine struck Rizhao in the eighth year. Famine struck Shangrao in the ninth year. Famine struck Wangdu and Laoting in the tenth year. Famine struck Xiong County in the thirteenth year. That winter, Shandan suffered famine.
89
光緒元年冬，海州饑。 二年春，日照、海陽、灤州饑。 三年，高陵大饑，餓斃男婦三千餘人； 靖遠、平涼、涇州、靈台、禮縣、文縣、合水大饑。 四年，唐縣等四十州縣饑，莊浪、階州、成縣、靈州、鞏昌、秦州各屬饑。 六年秋，邢台饑。 七年，通州等州縣饑。 九年秋，鶴峰州大饑。 十一年夏，霑化饑。 十三年冬，洮州、永昌饑。 十五年春，魚台饑。 二十一年春，邢台、灤州饑。 二十二年夏，太平饑。 二十三年，寧津饑。 二十四年冬，靖遠、靜寧、莊浪、丹噶爾饑。 二十五年秋，文縣饑。 二十六年夏，靖遠饑。 二十七年冬，洮州、靜寧、靈台饑。 二十九年，洮州仍饑。 三十三年秋，皋蘭饑。
During the first year of the Guangxu reign, Haizhou suffered famine. Famine struck Rizhao, Haiyang, and Luanzhou in the second year. In the third year, great famine at Gaoling left more than three thousand men and women dead of starvation; Great famine also ravaged Jingyuan, Pingliang, Jingzhou, Lingtai, Li County, Wen County, and Heshui. Famine struck Tang County and forty other prefectures and counties in the fourth year. Famine struck Xingtai in the sixth year. Famine struck Tongzhou and other prefectures and counties in the seventh year. Famine struck Hefeng Prefecture in the ninth year. Famine struck Zhanhua in the eleventh year. Famine struck Tao Prefecture and Yongchang in the thirteenth year. Famine struck Yutai in the fifteenth year. Famine struck Xingtai and Luanzhou in the twenty-first year. Famine struck Taiping in the twenty-second year. Famine struck Ningjin in the twenty-third year. Famine struck Jingyuan, Jingning, Zhuanglang, and Danggar in the twenty-fourth year. Famine struck Wen County in the twenty-fifth year. Famine struck Jingyuan in the twenty-sixth year. Famine struck Tao Prefecture, Jingning, and Lingtai in the twenty-seventh year. In the twenty-ninth year, famine continued to afflict Tao Prefecture. Famine struck Gaolan in the thirty-third year.
90
順治十五年六月，遂安雨黃沙。
In the sixth month of the fifteenth year of the Shunzhi reign, yellow sand fell as rain over Sui'an.
91
康熙元年十一月，曹縣雨土數日。 三十一年正月，襄垣雨土。 三十七年四月，龍門雨黃沙。 四十八年九月，丘縣黃埃障天。 六十年春，安定雨土。
In the eleventh month of the first year of the Kangxi reign, soil fell as rain over Cao County for several days. In the first month of the thirty-first year, soil fell as rain over Xiangyuan. In the fourth month of the thirty-seventh year, yellow sand fell as rain over Longmen. In the ninth month of the forty-eighth year, yellow dust blotted out the sky at Qiu County. In the spring of the sixtieth year, soil fell as rain over Anding.
92
乾隆四年三月，甘泉雨土。 十六年三月十五日，忠州夜雨黃土，著人物皆黃。 二十四年二月初七日，薊州雨黃土。 三月，永年雨黃土。 四十八年三月十四日，寧陝廳雨土。 五十年二月十五日，臨清雨土。 五十一年正月，文登、榮成雨土。 五十九年二月二十六日，翼城雨土。
In the third month of the fourth year of the Qianlong reign, soil fell as rain over Ganquan. On the fifteenth day of the third month of the sixteenth year, yellow soil rained at night over Zhongzhou, staining people and objects yellow. On the seventh day of the second month of the twenty-fourth year, yellow soil fell as rain over Jizhou. In the third month, yellow soil fell as rain over Yongnian. On the fourteenth day of the third month of the forty-eighth year, soil fell as rain over Ningshan Subprefecture. On the fifteenth day of the second month of the fiftieth year, soil fell as rain over Linqing. In the first month of the fifty-first year, soil fell as rain over Wendeng and Rongcheng. On the twenty-sixth day of the second month of the fifty-ninth year, soil fell as rain over Yicheng.
93
嘉慶十四年冬，泰州雨土。 二十三年四月，唐山雨土二寸許。 道光四年春，霑化雨土。
In the winter of the fourteenth year of the Jiaqing reign, soil fell as rain over Taizhou. In the fourth month of the twenty-third year, about two inches of soil fell as rain at Tangshan. In the spring of the fourth year of the Daoguang reign, soil fell as rain over Zhanhua.
94
咸豐三年二月，棲霞雨土。 三月，宜昌雨土。 六年三月二十三日，咸寧雨土。 同治三年春，麻城雨土。
In the second month of the third year of the Xianfeng reign, soil fell as rain over Qixia. In the third month, soil fell as rain over Yichang. On the twenty-third day of the third month of the sixth year of the Xianfeng reign, soil fell as rain over Xian'ning. In the spring of the third year of the Tongzhi reign, soil fell as rain over Macheng.
95
光緒四年二月二十九日，宜城雨黃沙。 三月，蓬萊雨土。
On the twenty-ninth day of the second month of the fourth year of the Guangxu reign, yellow sand fell as rain over Yicheng. In the third month, soil fell as rain over Penglai.
